title: Annual Board Examination Section A Simulator 5 (FBISE Class 12 Chemistry)
subject: chemistry-12

questions.question: Which of the following chlorides undergoes complete hydrolysis in water to produce an acidic solution and fumes of HCl?
questions.explanation: SiCl₄ possesses vacant 3d orbitals to accept lone pairs from water molecules, hydrolyzing violently to Si(OH)₄ and 4 HCl (unlike CCl₄ which lacks d-orbitals).

questions.question: The solubility of alkaline earth metal hydroxides down Group IIA (Be(OH)₂ to Ba(OH)₂):
questions.explanation: Lattice energy decreases more rapidly than hydration enthalpy down Group IIA for hydroxides; hence Ba(OH)₂ is the most soluble and basic.

questions.question: Tin exists in two allotropic forms: white tin (metallic β-tin) and grey tin (non-metallic α-tin). The crumbly disintegration of tin objects in freezing weather is called:
questions.explanation: Below 13.2°C, white metallic β-tin slowly converts to brittle, grey powdery α-tin with lower density, known as tin pest.

questions.question: Ozone (O₃) acts as a powerful oxidizing agent because:

options.A: It readily decomposes to release one molecule of oxygen and one highly reactive nascent oxygen atom [O]
options.D: It has a cyclic triangular shape

questions.explanation: O₃ → O₂ + [O]. The liberated nascent oxygen atom has immense oxidizing potential (E° = +2.07 V).

questions.question: Hydrofluoric acid (HF) is stored in wax-coated bottles or plastic (polyethylene) containers because:

options.A: It reacts with glass (silica) forming soluble fluorosilicic acid: SiO₂ + 6HF → H₂SiF₆ + 2H₂O
options.B: It is light-sensitive and decomposes into fluorine gas
options.D: It oxidizes glass into silicon metal

questions.explanation: HF attacks silicates in glass (etching of glass), forming gaseous SiF₄ and H₂SiF₆, destroying glass containers.

questions.question: The blue color of aqueous copper sulfate solution turns into an intense royal blue solution upon adding excess ammonia due to the formation of:
questions.explanation: Cu²⁺ forms the complex ion [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺ with ammine ligands, shifting the d-d absorption band and intensifying the blue color.

questions.question: Stereoisomers that are not mirror images of each other are called:
questions.explanation: Diastereomers have different spatial arrangements but are not mirror images (e.g., cis/trans isomers, non-mirror pairs of stereoisomers with multiple chiral centers).

questions.question: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) is manufactured under mild conditions (few atmospheres) using which coordination catalyst?
questions.explanation: Ziegler-Natta catalyst polymerizes ethene stereoregularly into unbranched, tightly packed linear chains with high crystallinity and tensile strength.

questions.question: What is the product obtained when benzene is hydrogenated under pressure at 200°C over a nickel catalyst?
When ethylmagnesium bromide reacts with ethylene oxide (oxirane) followed by acid hydrolysis, the product is:
questions.explanation: Grignard ring-opening of ethylene oxide adds a -CH₂CH₂OH unit: CH₃CH₂MgBr + (CH₂CH₂)O → CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂OH.

questions.question: When diethyl ether is treated with concentrated sulfuric acid in the cold, it dissolves by forming a stable, water-soluble:
questions.explanation: Ether oxygen has basic lone pairs that accept a proton from concentrated strong acids to form protonated oxonium salts.

questions.question: Trioxane (metaformaldehyde) is a cyclic trimer of formaldehyde with the formula:
questions.explanation: Distilling 50% aqueous formaldehyde with dilute H₂SO₄ yields crystalline cyclic trioxane [(CH₂O)₃].

Ninhydrin reagent reacts with all α-amino acids on heating to produce an intense blue-purple coloration known as:
questions.explanation: Oxidative deamination and condensation of ninhydrin with liberated ammonia generates the deep purple pigment Ruhemann's purple.

questions.question: Which Pakistan industry utilizes rock salt (NaCl) mined from Khewra as its primary raw material?

options.A: Chlor-alkali industry (Caustic soda, Chlorine) and Soda ash industry

questions.explanation: Brine from Khewra rock salt feeds large chlor-alkali and soda ash manufacturing facilities across Punjab.

questions.question: The international treaty signed in 1987 to phase out production and consumption of ozone-depleting substances (CFCs and halons) is known as the:
questions.explanation: The Montreal Protocol successfully regulated and phased out CFCs, stabilizing and beginning the recovery of the stratospheric ozone layer.

questions.question: What is the order of boiling points among isomeric primary, secondary, and tertiary butyl alcohols?
questions.explanation: Branching decreases molecular surface area and weakens van der Waals forces, while also sterically hindering hydrogen bonding; hence 1° > 2° > 3°.
